finding: Pipeline uses long-lived IAM access keys stored as CI secrets
risk_statement: An attacker who compromises the CI platform or a workflow could exfiltrate static keys and use them indefinitely to modify production infrastructure
mitigations: Replace with OIDC federation scoped to environment:production; SCP denies iam:CreateAccessKey

finding: Terraform state bucket readable by all developers; contains RDS master password
risk_statement: An insider or compromised developer credential could read prod state and obtain database credentials, leading to exposure of customer PII
mitigations: Use manage_master_user_password; restrict state read to apply role; CMK on bucket
